div.head: Hn 91.3
div.ab: Si etiam manerium, in quo murdrum inuenietur, de dominio et firma regis sit, et rex ita preceperit, per totum hundretum inde componendum erit.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 607 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

seg.hi: wie Bauern auf Krondomäne manches andere Vorrecht geniessen, so bringen sie Murdrumbusse nicht allein, sondern unterstützt von Nachbarorten auf

note.seg: just as peasants on the royal demesne enjoy many another privilege, so they do not raise the murdrum-fine alone, but with the support of neighbouring places
